description: Static routing contract covering every UES skill at least once while keeping each scenario focused.

scenarios.name: unknown-repository-feature
scenarios.prompt: Add a small feature to an unfamiliar repository and follow its existing conventions.

scenarios.name: cross-module-feature
scenarios.prompt: Implement a feature touching API, service, persistence, and tests.

scenarios.name: runtime-regression
scenarios.prompt: A previously working endpoint now crashes after a refactor. Find and fix the root cause.

scenarios.name: dependency-version-uncertainty
scenarios.prompt: Upgrade a library but first verify the current official API and compatible package version.

scenarios.name: public-api-change
scenarios.prompt: Change a public REST response contract used by multiple clients.

scenarios.name: database-migration
scenarios.prompt: Add a database migration and update the application code that depends on the new schema.

scenarios.name: authentication-change
scenarios.prompt: Change role permissions for an authenticated endpoint.

scenarios.name: large-repo-investigation
scenarios.prompt: Understand a large monorepo without loading unrelated code into context.

scenarios.name: long-running-migration
scenarios.prompt: Plan a risky multi-session migration that may need to be paused and resumed.

scenarios.name: react-native-bug
scenarios.prompt: Fix a React Native screen regression and add a focused regression test.

scenarios.name: ci-pipeline-failure
scenarios.prompt: GitHub Actions fails while local tests pass. Diagnose the CI environment difference.

scenarios.name: release-review
scenarios.prompt: Review the completed change for correctness and prove it is ready to release.

scenarios.name: new-behavior-tdd
scenarios.prompt: Add a behavior change in a repository that already has a fast unit test suite.

scenarios.name: current-framework-docs
scenarios.prompt: The framework API may have changed recently. Check primary documentation before editing.

scenarios.name: payment-flow-change
scenarios.prompt: Modify checkout payment handling without breaking retries or idempotency.

scenarios.name: security-audit
scenarios.prompt: Audit a web authentication flow for exploitable vulnerabilities and false positives.

scenarios.name: react-state-race
scenarios.prompt: Fix a React hook regression where an older request overwrites the newest screen state.

scenarios.name: nextjs-cache-auth
scenarios.prompt: Fix a Next.js App Router mutation that leaves stale cached data and must preserve server-only authorization.

scenarios.name: node-stream-shutdown
scenarios.prompt: Fix a Node.js service that leaks listeners and drops in-flight work during graceful shutdown.

scenarios.name: nestjs-module-auth
scenarios.prompt: Add a NestJS endpoint with DTO validation, module wiring, and resource authorization.

scenarios.name: python-async-service
scenarios.prompt: Fix a Python async service that blocks the event loop and leaks a resource on failure.

scenarios.name: django-permission-query
scenarios.prompt: Add a Django/DRF resource endpoint while preventing N+1 queries and object-level permission bypass.

scenarios.name: fastapi-contract
scenarios.prompt: Change a FastAPI request/response model and keep validation, auth dependencies, and OpenAPI behavior correct.

scenarios.name: dotnet-ef-api
scenarios.prompt: Implement an ASP.NET Core API change involving EF Core queries, cancellation, and authorization.

scenarios.name: spring-transaction-security
scenarios.prompt: Modify a Spring Boot service transaction and endpoint permission without breaking JPA behavior.

scenarios.name: flutter-async-ui
scenarios.prompt: Fix a Flutter screen where stale async results update disposed state and navigation behavior regresses.

scenarios.name: accessible-form
scenarios.prompt: Improve a form so keyboard, focus, labels, errors, screen readers, and responsive UI work correctly.

scenarios.name: secure-upload
scenarios.prompt: Implement image upload with size/type validation, safe storage keys, authorization, and orphan cleanup.

scenarios.name: marketplace-stock
scenarios.prompt: Fix a marketplace checkout that can oversell inventory and trusts client-submitted totals.

scenarios.name: performance-hot-path
scenarios.prompt: Investigate a slow endpoint and optimize only after identifying the dominant query or allocation cost.

scenarios.name: rest-idempotency
scenarios.prompt: Design a retry-safe REST write endpoint with stable errors, pagination conventions, and resource authorization.

scenarios.name: architecture-boundary
scenarios.prompt: Plan an incremental architecture change across modules with explicit contracts, rollout, rollback, and failure boundaries.

scenarios.name: docs-after-cli-change
scenarios.prompt: Update setup and CLI documentation after behavior changed, verifying every command and path from the repository.

scenarios.name: implementation-refactor
scenarios.prompt: Implement a multi-file refactor while preserving contracts, validation, tests, and unrelated user changes.
